$comment: Accepted HIGH/CRITICAL production advisories (phase 11 M3). Each entry needs a GHSA id, the package, a justification and an expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD); an expired entry blocks CI again. Checked by apps/api/scripts/security/audit-gate.ts.

exceptions.reason: postcss 8.4.31 is pinned by next 15.5 and only processes our own CSS at build time; the file read needs an attacker-controlled sourceMappingURL in CSS, which never reaches it.
Same dependency path as above (next > postcss 8.4.31): only our own, build-time CSS is processed; no untrusted CSS input exists in the product.

Only inside the Prisma CLI config loader (@prisma/config), which merges only our own prisma.config.ts; the stack exhaustion needs an attacker-supplied recursive object graph, which never reaches it. Prisma is pinned at 7.10.0 (ADR / CLAUDE.md).
Transitive dependency of the Prisma CLI; SmartOps uses PostgreSQL only, the MySQL driver is never loaded.
